question: Does optimizing actuator values add to posterior-risk motif selection?
rule: Score every permitted pair action using the existing posterior-risk calculation. Select the motif whose best candidate has the largest score. At that motif ignore the maximizing value and use a deterministic visit-count cycle (-2,-2), (-2,+2), (+2,-2), (+2,+2). The cycle is separate for each motif.
development_decision: Report all three paired systems, exact actions and costs. This reused-system screen cannot promote value optimization. Consider a fresh frozen test only after replay and parity validation.
limits: The two policies can visit different motifs because their posteriors diverge after the first selected action. This control isolates the policy rule but not an identical action-path counterfactual.
forbidden: No tuning of the cycle after outcomes; no closed-source model API
